hooks.command: command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || uvx() { uv tool run "$@"; }; p="${MEMBRAIN_PACKAGE:-membrain-ai[embedded,semantic] @ https://github.com/chriswu727/membrain/archive/6106561a77102c4eb87c10524007f6fcc9cade5a.zip}"; c="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}/constraints.txt"; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && { { [ -f "$c" ] && uv tool install --quiet --python 3.12 --constraints "$c" "$p"; } || uv tool install --quiet --python 3.12 "$p"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin start >/dev/null 2>&1; true

export UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=2; if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || uvx() { uv tool run "$@"; }; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook session-start --host codex 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"memBrain is installed but its runtime is not ready yet, so nothing is remembered or recalled until it is. It installs in the background; the first time needs an internet connection and takes a few minutes. Memory then starts by itself; no new session is needed. In your first reply, tell the user this once, and that if they see it again in a later session the installation is failing, for example without an internet connection."}}'; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"memBrain is installed but cannot run: uv was not found on this computer, so nothing is remembered or recalled. In your first reply, tell the user this once and ask them to install uv from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/ and then start a new session."}}'; fi; true
export UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=2; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || uvx() { uv tool run "$@"; }; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook user-prompt --host codex 2>/dev/null; true
export UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=2; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || uvx() { uv tool run "$@"; }; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook stop --host codex 2>/dev/null; true
